structured.answer: I'm not deciding anything. I'll ask my son or someone I trust. I did see that Harel has 96 tracks with fees of about 0.5–0.6% a year, and that the "כספי (שקלי)" track showed about 4.25% over 3 years, but I'm not sure it's really as safe as a deposit, or worth it after the fee.

stuck.where: First screen, header and product buttons
stuck.why: It opens with 105 products and 96 tracks, shares, מט"ח and S&P 500 on a dark screen, and nothing about deposits or safe saving
Most rows have no return number, so there was nothing to compare
I couldn't tell if this is like a deposit, or whether 4.25% is per year or for the 3 years together
The same rows repeat over and over and I lost track of which product I was in

Every row repeats the same words (ההחיסכון, ההפקדה, מניות, מט"ח) and the same ring, so I re-read them all to find what differs
The ring charts in two close colours, with their percentages written beside them and not on them
Most returns say "פחות מ־3 שנים", so there's nothing to compare
Dark background with very many numbers makes it anxious and tiring
Small pale grey text I couldn't read
